svg.text: K1b The arm tip: magnet roll through a closed can, one stub for every tool
The roll drive passes a welded 0.5 mm steel wall by magnets: no seal, no bore at the tip. Tools lock by a push and 60° of roll.
roll coupling: 12 + 12 magnets, gap 2.5 mm, rated 10 Nm, slips at ≈ 15 Nm
sleeve on two PEEK bushes, held by a 2-lug bayonet · 0–150 rpm
H stub on every tool and vessel: Ø 22 × 40, two pins, above a drip collar
replaces K1: core lip seals, hex drive and Ø 4 bore at every rod tip

g.text: 1/5 Push in: the hand moves the empty socket along the arm axis over the tool stub resting in its holder; the drip collar stays outside
2/5 Lock: 60° of roll turns the J-slots behind the two pins — the tool is held; nothing in the tool moves
3/5 Check: the Z load cell weighs the grip; a wrong or missing tool is found before anything moves
4/5 Work: the dry rotor drives the wet sleeve through the closed can (≤ 10 Nm); overload: the magnets slip, the arm is safe
5/5 Release: roll back 60°, withdraw; the socket is rinsed at the dump slot before the next tool
